title: Automate shared AI context freshness

issue.title: TASK-b4d1 Automate shared AI context freshness

description: Keep docs/ai-context.md trustworthy through deterministic source fingerprints, a maintainer refresh command, and scheduled/triggered CI freshness checks.
requirements: Add a deterministic repository-side AI context freshness validator.
Track fingerprints of authoritative source files used by the context.
Add a GitHub Actions workflow that validates context on relevant changes and on a weekly schedule.
Detect stale context and create or update an actionable GitHub issue instead of silently passing.
Provide a maintainer-friendly command to refresh the context fingerprint after intentional context updates.
Document the automation and source-of-truth hierarchy.
Do not bypass the protected main branch or auto-merge changes.
definitionOfReady: GitHub Issue #126 exists with goal and acceptance criteria.
Dedicated branch task/b4d1-ai-context-freshness created from main.
AGENTS.md, README.md, package.json, task registry, and current AI context reviewed.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate-ai-context.mjs can check and refresh the generated fingerprint block.
.github/workflows/ai-context.yml runs on relevant pushes and weekly schedule.
Stale context produces a clear CI failure and an actionable GitHub issue without changing main.
Task metadata is valid and the implementation PR targets main.
technicalApproach: Use Git blob SHA fingerprints for a small, explicit set of authoritative repository sources.
Keep the substantive AI context human-readable; only the fingerprint block is generated.
Use GitHub Actions schedule and path triggers for proactive freshness checks.
Use the GitHub CLI with GITHUB_TOKEN only to report an existing/new stale-context issue.
definitionOfDone: npm run ai-context:check passes on the final branch.
Relevant workflow/config validation passes or is reported if unavailable.
Task history and commit metadata are updated.

decisionLog.decision: Use deterministic source fingerprints rather than trying to infer semantic freshness automatically.
decisionLog.reason: The repository can reliably detect that authoritative inputs changed; semantic context edits still require an intentional human/agent refresh and review.
